parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the received messages.

Valid values:

- **zh**: (default) Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: TaskData
parameters.description: The request query conditions for the download task. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns error code -340408 (download task TaskData invalid).

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description: The task type. For valid values, call the operation that queries file download task types.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: The time zone for time information in the downloaded file. Specify the value in IANA time zone identity format. Default value: Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8).
